items.question: Do you offer 24/7 emergency plumbing?
items.answer: Yes. Our emergency line is open around the clock, every day of the year. A licensed technician is always on call for urgent leaks, blockages and burst pipes.

items.question: Are your plumbers licensed and insured?
items.answer: Every BlueDrop technician is fully licensed, background-checked and insured, so you can feel completely confident letting us into your home.

items.question: How much does a call-out cost?
items.answer: We give clear, upfront pricing before any work begins. You'll always approve the quote first, with no surprise charges added afterward.

items.question: How quickly can you come out?
items.answer: For emergencies we aim to be on-site within the hour. For scheduled work we'll book the earliest slot that suits you, often same-day.
